> Exotic and luxury car rental in Beverly Hills, CA. Facts from falconcarrental.com. This is a free concept, not their official site.

- Address: 499 N Canon Dr, Beverly Hills, CA 90210
- Hours: Mon-Fri 8 AM to 8 PM, Sat-Sun 8 AM to 6 PM

## Services
- Airport and hotel delivery
- Pick-up and drop-off
- One-way rentals
- Chauffeur services
- Multi-day discounts: 15 percent for 7 to 27 days, 30 percent for 28 days or more
- Cryptocurrency payments accepted

## Areas served
Orange County, Newport Beach, Santa Barbara, Palm Springs, San Diego, Las Vegas, Phoenix, airports across California.
